column2: DANGER Baggage Make-Up Carousel Sign – Overlapping Plates Can Trap Hands – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Overlapping Plates Can Trap Hands. This DANGER Baggage Make-Up Carousel sign from CGAP Safety reads: MAKE-UP CAROUSEL / OVERLAPPING PLATES MOVE / CAN TRAP HANDS AND ARMS / NEVER REACH UNDER PLATES. Written for airport baggage handling systems, airline bag rooms and BHS maintenance contractors.

Why this sign matters

Sliding overlapping plates and the gaps at the carousel edge close on hands or sleeves reaching under or between plates and drag the arm in.

Where to post it

On the carousel frame at each loading position in the make-up area.

Who orders it

Ramp agent, baggage room supervisor.
